description: Strict dense Qwen3.8-27B RTX 4090 lane. New artifacts may use only FP8-CB K40/K44/K48 plus dynamic-FP8 and BF16 terminals. NVFP4, NVFP4-CB, and the remaining FP8-CB reader wire ids are compatibility only and are refused before allocation/export. Hardware and graph qualification are separate, contract-attested ship gates; this format profile alone never claims that an Ada route is qualified.

format_rules.detail: The RTX 4090 Qwen3.8 campaign is FP8-CB only. It must never spend an assignment on NVFP4/NVFP4-CB, whose native FP4 tensor-core contract is Blackwell-specific.
Only FP8_CB_K40/K44/K48 and the dynamic-FP8/BF16 terminals are legal. The other K28..K48 FP8-CB rungs remain readable but cannot enter this producer menu.
